properties.name: Hwy20B
properties.desc: Highway 20, Rainy Pass, PCT crosses the highway, then joins a paved and unpaved road 3/10 mile N to a trailhead parking area.

properties.name: RainyPassTR
properties.desc: Rainy Pass Trailhead, parking, outhouse, trail register.

properties.name: MethowPass
properties.desc: Methow Pass, small campsite in the saddle of the pass.

properties.name: WForkMethowRiver
properties.desc: West Fork Methow River, wooden bridge, established campsite nearby.

properties.name: HartsPass
properties.desc: Harts Pass, unpaved road, campground, outhouse, picnic tables, guard station. PCT joins the leftmost unpaved road for 100 feet at the three-way junction of unpaved roads, then departs the unpaved road

properties.name: TR2623
properties.desc: Trail junction to a road and trailhead parking.

properties.name: WACS2628
properties.desc: Seasonal stream at the foot of Tamarack Peak, large campsite nearby.

properties.name: HolmanPass
properties.desc: Holman Pass, trail junctions to West Fork Pasayten River, Devils Pass.

properties.name: HopkinsLakeTR
properties.desc: Unmarked spur trail to Hopkins Lake. Lake is 1/10 mile S of PCT with camping, water.

properties.name: CastlePass2
properties.desc: Castle Pass, several campsites, Ross Lake Trail junction

properties.name: WA2650
properties.desc: Seasonal stream [larger than most in this area].

properties.name: Monument78
properties.desc: Monument 78, Canadian/US border, small metal obelisk nearby has been filled with concrete and no longer contains the trail register. The trail register has been put inside a nearby log.

properties.name: CastleCreek
properties.desc: Castle Creek, wooden bridge, trail camp nearby with outhouse, fire grates, bear locker, corral.

properties.name: GibsonPassRD
properties.desc: Turn right on Gibson Pass Road, head east toward Highway 3 and Manning Park Lodge. Trailhead parking nearby.

properties.name: Hwy3B
properties.desc: Highway 3, near the Manning Park Lodge [manningpark.com]. The Manning Park offers lodging, restaurant, small store, and a Greyhound bus stop.
